headline: NVIDIA contributes OpenShell to the CNCF as an open governance project
summary: On Nov 10, 2026, NVIDIA announced that it had contributed OpenShell, an open-source runtime for governing autonomous AI agents, to the Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) as a Sandbox project. NVIDIA and CNCF describe community-led, vendor-neutral stewardship and identify policy enforcement around agent tools, resources, credentials, inference and network access as the project’s intended role. The project’s acceptance as a CNCF Sandbox was previously recorded for Sep 26; the new event is the contribution and governance transition announcement. No independent security evaluation or deployment outcome is established here.
